stories.title: Game 3 Recap — White Sox Shut Out Cubs, Series Splits 3-3
stories.angle: White Sox used opener Sean Newcomb (2 hitless IP) then José Urquidy — 8 K, 0 BB, held Cubs to 2 total hits. Clay Holmes (Cubs) gave 5.1 IP, 1 ER — quality start with no run support. Tyrone Taylor the only Cub with hits (2). Series split 3-3. Score omitted per has_score=False insight.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
José Urquidy came on in the third inning and didn't let the Cubs breathe — eight strikeouts, no walks, two hits allowed total.

Clay Holmes gave them 5.1 innings and one run. The offense never found an answer.

Series ends 3-3. Off to Seattle.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Cardinals Reality Check — Won the Series, Still 13.5 Back
stories.angle: Cardinals won 2 of 3 in their August series vs Cubs. Still 13.5 games back in the NL Central. Rival jab: beating a playoff team in August doesn't make you a contender when you're that far out.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
The Cardinals won two games against the Cubs this month. They're still 13.5 games back in the NL Central.

Beating a playoff team in August doesn't make you a contender. Ask St. Louis to explain the math.

Chicago's focus is October.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Dansby Swanson Update — Grade 2 Oblique, 4-Week Target
stories.angle: MRI confirmed Grade 2 left oblique strain. Counsell's target: four weeks, which puts Swanson back in the lineup ~mid-September. Hoerner at SS, Ramírez at 2B in the interim. Silver lining: if the window holds, Swanson is healthy for the postseason.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Dansby Swanson's MRI: Grade 2 oblique strain. Target return is four weeks — puts him back in the lineup by mid-September.

Hoerner at short, Ramírez at second in the meantime.

If that window holds, Swanson's healthy for October.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Wild Card Standings — Cubs Hold WC1, 7 Brewers H2H Games Left
stories.angle: Cubs hold NL Wild Card No. 1 with Phillies ~5 games back. Brewers lead NL Central by ~4 games. Seven remaining head-to-head games vs Milwaukee (Aug 31-Sep 3, Sep 7-9) = Cubs control their own destiny in the division race.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
The Cubs hold NL Wild Card No. 1 with the Phillies five games back. Brewers lead the NL Central by four.

Six weeks left in the season. Seven head-to-head games with Milwaukee still to play.

This race isn't over — in either direction.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Jaxon Wiggins September Callup — Relief Role Unlocks Elite Stuff
stories.angle: Cubs No. 2 prospect Jaxon Wiggins made his first Iowa relief appearance. Touched 98 mph. One inning, zero runs, two strikeouts. Control issues as a starter have held him back (>1 BB/IP in Iowa); short stints may be the answer. September callup case building.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Jaxon Wiggins touched 98 mph in his first Iowa relief appearance. One inning, zero runs, two strikeouts.

The No. 2 Cubs prospect's control has been the question. The bullpen role might be the answer.

September callup case is building.

#Cubs #GoCubs #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong Off-Day Appreciation — 30-30 at 24
stories.angle: PCA has 30 HR and 31 SB with a .938 OPS at age 24. Second consecutive 30-30 season — first Cub ever to do it in back-to-back years. Bold take: the NL MVP race should already be settled.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong has 30 home runs and 31 stolen bases this season.

He's 24 years old. Playing center field. Posting a .938 OPS. On a team in the October conversation.

The NL MVP race should already be wrapping up.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Steele and Brown Bullpen Updates — Cavalry May Arrive
stories.angle: Justin Steele targeting September bullpen return (not a starter). Ben Brown is pain-free and throwing live sessions. Neither is coming back as a starter, but two extra arms — even in relief — could reshape the playoff pitching picture for October.

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
Justin Steele is targeting a September bullpen return. Ben Brown is pain-free and throwing live sessions.

Two healthy arms — even in relief — could reshape the playoff pitching picture.

The cavalry might actually show up.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB
